### **Data Dictionary**

#### **`cafe.csv`**

| **variable** | **class** | **description** |
|-----------------|---------------|----------------------------------------|
| country | character | The country of the cafe. |
| city | character | The city of the cafe. |
| urban | logical | Whether the cafe is in an urban area. |
| suburban | logical | Whether the cafe is in a suburban area. |
| rural | logical | Whether the cafe is in a rural area. |
| hourly_wage_gbp | double | The hourly wage of a barista working in the cafe, converted to British pounds. |
| price_gbp | double | The price of a small cappuccino from the cafe, converted to British pounds. |
| original_currency | character | The original currency used by the cafe. |
| price | double | The price of a small cappuccino from the cafe, in the original currency. |
| hourly_wage | double | The hourly wage of a barista working in the cafe, in the original currency. |

#### **`cappuccino_index.csv`**

| **variable** | **class** | **description** |
|-----------------|----------------|----------------------------------------|
| country | character | Name of country for which cappuccino index was calculated. |
| index | double | The cappuccino index: the time in minutes a barista needs to work to afford a small cappuccino in their country. |
| n | integer | Number of cafes that were included in the calculation of the index. |
| minutes | double | The number of whole minutes in index. |
| seconds | double | The remaining number of seconds in index. |
| index_as_time | character | Index formatted as minutes and seconds, i.e., MM:SS. |

It takes **about 3 minutes per cappuccino from order to hand-off** (measured by me when I order my morning cappuccino).

Looking at Bulgaria. Only 1 out of 6 records was for a cafe not in an urban area so leaving only urban.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-bulgaria-cafe-data

(bg_cafe <-
    cafe |>
    filter(country == "Bulgaria" & urban == TRUE) |>
    select(city, price, hourly_wage) |>
    group_by(city) |>
    summarise(
      avg_price = mean(price),
      avg_hourly_wage = mean(hourly_wage),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: calculate-cappuccinos-needed

cappuccino_time_min <- 3

(cappuccino_affordability <- 
  bg_cafe |>
  mutate(
    wage_per_cappuccino = avg_hourly_wage * (cappuccino_time_min / 60),
    cappuccinos_needed = avg_price / wage_per_cappuccino
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(cappuccinos_needed))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: city-position

(coffee_data <- 
  cappuccino_affordability |>
  mutate(
    cups = round(cappuccinos_needed),
    city_position = row_number()
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: cups-position

# Three cups per row, centered on each city's x position
(coffee_icons <- 
  coffee_data |>
  uncount(cups, .id = "cup_number") |>
  mutate(
    x = city_position + ((cup_number - 1) %% 3 - 1) * 0.20,
    y = (cup_number - 1) %/% 3 + 0.5
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: cofee-image

fontawesome::fa_png(
  name = "mug-hot",
  file = "images/mug-hot.png",
  fill = "#5C341E",
  prefer_type = "solid",
  height = 200
)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot

cappuccino_plot <-
  ggplot(
  coffee_icons, 
  aes(x, y)
) +
  geom_image(
    image = "images/mug-hot.png",
    size = 0.09,
    by = "height"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = coffee_data$city_position,
    labels = coffee_data$city,
    limits = c(0.5, nrow(coffee_data) + 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 7),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = str_wrap(
      "How many small cappuccinos does a barista in Bulgaria need to make in order to afford one*"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "*Data for Bulgaria is represented by 5 urban cafes. \n\n",
      "**On average it takes about 3 minutes per cappuccino from order to hand off - personal measurement. \n\n",
      "Source: The Cappuccino Index by James Hoffmann, ",
      "data curated by Filip Reierson | Viz: Veneta Karamfilova"
    )
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) + 
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#EFE9E1", 
      colour = NA
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      colour = "#2F180B",
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold", 
      color = "#2F180B", 
      size = 22
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      colour = "gray50",
      size = 10,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = -10,
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 40, 20)
  )

cappuccino_plot
```
